title: Flawed app and terrible web support
text: Flawed app and terrible web support. The app is terrible and will not get past the Activate Roomba screen. The support section of the web site is terrible. But the thing without the app will still work as long as I manually track it down and put it back on the charging station. As for cleaning - it definitely does the job, so I will keep it. If you want vacuum that will do everything it's advertised to do, including being controlled from an app or Alexa this is not it. Look elsewhere.
